resources.string: Detox uses this to notice WHICH app you open, nothing more. When a paused app opens during a quiet time, after your daily limit or while strict mode is on, Detox closes it. It cannot read your screen, messages or passwords. Detox has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
Closes paused apps at the times you choose
Detox is a calm bouncer for your phone. It only notices which app opens, so it can close social media during your quiet times.
